mapper.select: SELECT TOP 1 ProductCode FROM ComProduct ORDER BY ProductCode DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ComProduct ( ProductCode, ProcessCode, GroupCode, ProductName, Price, InsertDate, InsertUserID ) VALUES ( #{productCode}, #{processCode}, #{groupCode}, #{productName}, #{price}, GETDATE(), #{insertUserId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE ComProduct SET ProductName = #{productName}, Price = #{price}, UpdateUserID = #{updateUserId}, UpdateDate = GETDATE() WHERE ProductCode = #{productCode}
